subject: Summit sponsor demo bundle credits — allocation & delivery plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Summit sponsor demo bundle credits — allocation & delivery plan

Marissa / Monica,

Peak Marketing (Eric) just confirmed sponsorship for the Bay Summit on May 21. They want demo-bundle access codes to give to their 200+ booth visitors — a mix of 1-week trial bundles (50), 1-month workshop access (120), and 30 lightweight inference credits (30 qty).

Can we:
- Approve a one-off promo pool from the events budget (est. 2,700 credits total)
- Create a unique sponsor passcode set (10k batch key, redeemable per attendee)
- Include the attached bundle-terms and a short redemption flow doc for booth staff

I put together a draft allocation in sponsor-credit-matrix.xlsx (attached). Need sign-off and ops owner for code generation + distribution by Tue 4/20 EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sponsor-credit-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: bundle-terms.pdf (PDF stub)

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit sponsor demo bundle credits — allocation & delivery plan

Thanks Karthik — looks reasonable. A couple of notes:
- Events budget can cover up to 3k credits for partner co-op this quarter; please tag the spend to "Q2 Summit Sponsorship" in the expense tracker.
- For the passcode format, ops prefers short, human-readable codes (e.g., RED-SUMMIT-XXXX) so booth staff can read them aloud.
- We should lock the 1-week trials to new accounts only; the longer workshop access should require an email capture (booth handshake).

Monica — can you own generation + distribution? If you want, we can limit the 1-month activations to 120 and keep 30 high-value inference credits for partner follow-ups.

Marissa
VP, Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit sponsor demo bundle credits — allocation & delivery plan

On Mon, Apr 20, 2026 at 08:45 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Can we:
> - Approve a one-off promo pool from the events budget (est. 2,700 credits total)
> - Create a unique sponsor passcode set (10k batch key, redeemable per attendee)
> - Include the attached bundle-terms and a short redemption flow doc for booth staff

Happy to take this on. Plan:
1) Generate three code pools today (internal ops script):
   - 50 x 1-week-trial codes (TRIAL-1W-XXXX)
   - 120 x 1-month-workshop codes (WORK-1M-XXXX)
   - 30 x 30-credit packs (CRED-30-XXXX)
2) Upload CSV to secured Drive folder and share one-time download with Peak Marketing.
3) Embed brief redemption instructions and the bundle-terms.pdf into the shared folder.
4) I'll also add metadata flags to each passcode for tracking (redeemed_by_email, issued_at, code_type).

Requesting final approval to create the codes and share with Eric by Tue 4/20 5pm PT.

Monica
Partnerships Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: bundle-terms.pdf

From: Eric Tan <eric.tan@peakmarketing.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Summit sponsor demo bundle credits — allocation & delivery plan

Thanks Karthik / Monica — Peak Marketing is good to proceed. Couple of asks from our side:
- Can we get a single CSV with code, type, and brief redemption note for the booth lead?
- We need a short legal blurb to include in our materials that clarifies billing (these are promotional credits, non-transferrable).
- Will you provide a DocuSign for the addendum? Our procurement needs it signed before code distribution.

If you can get the codes and a draft addendum over by EOD Tue we can route it internally. Also please send invoice details so we have the sponsorship line-item for reconciliation.

Best,
Eric
Sponsorship Lead — Peak Marketing

- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/summit/PM-addendum (draft ready for signature; CC finance@peakmarketing.com as requested)
- Invoice: sent to procurement@peakmarketing.com with reference DEAL-8342-PM (invoice #INV-4041).

Monica will deliver the single CSV to your booth lead and provide a one-time passcode sheet. Let me know if you want codes rotated mid-day or replaced post-event.

Looking forward to a smooth activation.

Karthik
